extension.summary: Sync your Silo movies and TV shows into the Kodi library
extension.description: KodiConnectForSilo writes the movies and TV shows on your Silo server into Kodi's own video library, so every skin, widget and library feature treats them like local media. Watched state and resume points stay in step both ways, and playback streams from Silo: the original file when Kodi can play it, a converted stream otherwise. Community project: not made or endorsed by the Silo team.
extension.disclaimer: Do not run Kodi's "Clean library" on Silo items; KodiConnectForSilo manages them itself.
extension.news:
0.14.1: plays the audio track Silo picks for your profile, so a file with another language first (a MULTi release) plays in your language.
0.14.0: for Skyline: a person's titles not on your server, to request (needs TMDb Helper), and the remote's Play/Pause plays a title's card from any row. A session left open when Kodi closes or crashes during playback is ended on Silo at the next start.
0.13.1: restores films that had lost their library row to another film, and stops that happening. Kodi now says when syncs keep failing.
0.13.0: SiloKodiConnect is now KodiConnectForSilo, to follow Silo's naming policy. Your sign-in, settings and library move across by themselves; you can then uninstall the old add-on. Syncing works again with Silo's latest version, which had stopped each sync after Movies.
0.12.3: for Skyline's YouTube page: search from its box, Back closes the results, and the menu key offers Play or Play choosing the video's quality.
0.12.2: steadier: the service keeps running through an unexpected error, and repeated jobs no longer queue up behind a long sync.
0.12.1: new titles' artwork no longer stays blank after Kodi starts, Continue Watching follows a finished episode in about 2 s, a full resync shows its progress and fetches artwork again, and "Remove and re-add every Silo item" rebuilds at once.
